boundary: Exact six current storage methods and CSV parser/Spend aggregator; real isolated PostgreSQL, current four-table generated schema. No app HTTP/auth/browser/scheduler/provider/report or import persistence/recompute path. Fixture owner filtering is an assertion, not an authorization test.

localAcceptance.criteria: Zero incorrect totals/errors and p95 component read batch under1000ms; each10k-row parse/aggregate under1000ms. Provisional local characterization threshold, not deployed SLA.

limitations: Short warm-up/bounded run, not a sustained load or saturation test.
Database and Node run on same workstation; no HTTP/network/browser/Clerk/provider latency.
Only Spend read subset and CSV computation; missing Revenue, GA4 publication, actual import transaction/recompute, exports, reports and competing jobs.
All rows synthetic. Database query plan/resource usage and Render capacity are not inferred.
Pool queue sampling can miss sub5ms spikes; process memory/CPU excludes PostgreSQL and Chromium.
